channel.description: Latest articles from Scottish Daily Express (scottishdailyexpress.co.uk)

item.title: Bad news for the Nats... Scexit-supporting George Galloway is YOUR problem now!
item.description: The firebrand politician was a staunch campaigner for the Union in the 2014 independence referendum but he's changed his mind as he bids to get elected to Holyrood in Nicola Sturgeon's old Glasgow Southside seat

item.title: Nicola Sturgeon claims Operation Branchform made her 'stronger'
item.description: The former First Minister opened up about the long-running investigation into the SNP's finances, which saw her estranged husband Peter Murrell charged with embezzlement

item.title: Alan Carr explains why he bought a £3.25m Scottish castle for his Disney+ show
item.description: The Celebrity Traitors winner has big plans for Ayton Castle in the Borders, with the trials and tribulations of his new life to be recorded for a reality TV show called 'Castle Man'

item.title: A pragmatic middle path for North Sea oil and gas needed for Scotland to survive
item.description: EXPRESS LETTERS, TUESDAY, MARCH 24, 2026: The thorny issue of energy – both at home and in the wider world – is still uppermost in the minds of many readers

item.title: SNP Government loaned £286m to Sanjeev Gupta without 'adequate' background check
item.description: Nicola Sturgeon and John Swinney were wined and dined by Sanjeev Gupta as he persuaded them to hand over millions to help him buy steel plants and a smelter in Scotland.

item.title: Top Nat Linden weeps in court during sex pest trial as he admits being 'naive'
item.description: The former leader of North Lanarkshire Council, who faces 15 charges including sexual assault, struggled to maintain his composure on the fifth day of his trial at Falkirk Sheriff Court

item.title: Fed up Scots may face ANOTHER election as Joani Reid's future as an MP in doubt
item.description: The Scottish Labour MP – whose husband has been arrested on suspicion of spying for China – is said to have launched an 'inappropriate relationship' with a submarine officer at Faslane navy base

item.title: John Swinney's grotesque hypocrisy exposed by SNP reaction to Pam Duncan-Glancy
item.description: The Nat leader has refused to remove a candidate who turned out as a defence witness for sex offender Jordan Linden - in stark contrast to his party's reaction to the former Scottish Labour MSP

item.title: Neil Gray 'insults' patients by branding bottled water 'hotel-level service'
item.description: The SNP's health secretary denied claims from oppositions MSPs that cancer patients at the Queen Elizabeth University Hospital were being given bottled water because it was unsafe

item.title: Scottish Labour drop Glasgow Southside candidate after fraud charge
item.description: Mohammed Ameen, appeared at Ayr Sherriff Court, over a single charge of fraud last week

item.title: Royal wedding set for June as King Charles and Prince William 'made aware'
item.description: Peter Philips, the son of Princess Anne, will wed for a second time during the summer, to NHS nurse Harriet Sperling.

item.title: SNP 'can't be trusted' as Swinney pledges Japan-style health checks for Scotland
item.description: The First Minister was criticised over the proposals after the latest public health service data showed the government had failed again to meet its targets to cut waiting list

item.title: Immigration is 'why council tax bills are increasing' in Scotland as SNP blasted
item.description: Reform leader Malcolm Offord suggested that local authorities were hiking up council tax rates to help pay for housing asylum seekers who flock north of the border to claim housing, with Glasgow becoming the asylum seeker capital of the UK.

item.title: SNP candidate axed hours after being defended by John Swinney
item.description: Tracy Carragher has been suspended by the SNP over her links to a convicted sex offender and will no longer be leader of the party's North Lanarkshire council group.

item.title: Police Scotland urged to stop 'wasting time' probing legal social media posts
item.description: Scottish Conservative candidate Murdo Fraser called on Police Scotland to stop officers to investigating non-crime hate incidents
